create_SpeculatorAsync: create a SpeculatorAsync instance with lookahead, device, async_fan_out, max_blocks, vocab_size, draft_dtype, kvcache_block_size, max_model_len, async_pg, draft_runner_rank, tokenizer, and verbose parameters
run_prefill: run the prefill method on a list of Sequence objects with a VerifyResult to send command, metadata, input_ids, and optional eagle_acts to the draft runner rank
run_speculate: run the speculate method on a list of Sequence objects with a VerifyResult to append recovery tokens, send speculation requests, and return speculations with logits and cache hits
build_speculation_request: build a speculation request by filling handshake buffers with sequence cache keys, token counts, temperatures, block tables, and optional eagle activations then receive fused response and logits
alloc_handshake_buffers: allocate and initialize handshake send/recv buffers for a given batch size including cmd, metadata, cache keys, token counts, temperatures, block tables, fused response, logits, and extend counts tensors
